# foreman_usergroup (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_usergroup" "operators" {
  name = "Operators"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the usergroup to look up.

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) is an admin user group, can be modified by admins only
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
